Name: Hungry Hungry Animals
Author: klatuprism
Description:
Basic Stardew Valley has always been a polite little world. Even if your animals wandered straight into your crops, they behaved like perfect fluffy angels and politely [i]didn’t[/i] eat anything. Fences? Purely decorative. Aesthetic. Farm chic.

Well… not anymore!

This mod shakes things up! Now, when your animals go out hunting for grass, if they stumble across your crops first, they’ll happily treat them like an all-you-can-eat buffet. And because farm animals are about as delicate as a toddler with a juice box, their “snacking” is a bit… enthusiastic. Your crops? Gone. Poof. Deliciously destroyed.

The good news: each crop they eat fills them up just like grass, and they’ll only chow down one crop per day per animal. Plus, they get the same happiness boost as if they had eaten grass—apparently your suffering is nutritious.



Source code: [url=https://github.com/Prism-99/Hungry-Hungry-Animals]Github[/url]
